user_saw: When a user sent a follow-up immediately after a Telegram bot reply, the bot's typing indicator took about five seconds to appear.
summary: The fix clears the chat or topic's typing gate after successful Telegram message delivery and prevents an older pending action from restoring it.
reasoning: The locally available July snapshot already configured a four-second chat-action gate with no delivery invalidation, and the July lifecycle fix retained that interval. The September forum-topic change moved the existing gate into the account throttler and added topic keys. The older path history stopped at a missing object, so I could not verify when the gate was introduced or establish that immediate follow-up typing had previously worked.
